name: An unknown :repoId renders the repo-scoped 404 boundary
description: Covers the path that has no other coverage: a repo id in the URL that matches no repo in the workspace. Both repo-scoped screens (PR list, PR detail) call notFound() when `useRepoNotFound` turns true, and Next renders app/repos/[repoId]/not-found.tsx — one boundary owning the copy that the two screens each used to render inline. Asserted through the visible copy from messages/en/common.json (`repoNotFound.title` = 'No repo selected'), which is what a user actually sees. The uuid below is well-formed but absent from the seed, so the server answers and the CLIENT decides: this also proves the boundary fires after the repos list resolves rather than on a loading flash. What this flow deliberately does NOT assert: that the nav/breadcrumb is still present (positive locators only — see docs/adding-a-flow.md), and the timing rule that `useRepoNotFound` stays false while repos load, which is unit-test territory.

steps.label: open the PR list for a repo id that does not exist
the repo-scoped 404 boundary renders instead of the PR table
the same unknown repo, one level deeper (PR detail)
the PR detail screen reaches the same boundary
